UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Private profile and organisation memberships for a signed-in user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

memberships.description: Bounded list (<= 30) of organisations the user belongs to.

pendingRequests.description: Bounded list (<= 20) of pending join requests submitted by the user.

OrgCodeReservation.title: OrgCodeReservation
OrgCodeReservation.description: Exact-lookup reservation mapping a unique lowercase organisation code to its orgId and public display name only.

Organisation.title: Organisation
Organisation.description: Multi-tenant organisation holding one or more schools, members, settings, and audit logs.

OrgMember.title: OrgMember
OrgMember.description: Member record with role, allowed schools, 14-module permissions (including Phase 10 Certificates, Cash Book, and Enquiry with backward-compatible missing-key = none), teacher profile fields, and activity timestamp.

JoinRequest.title: JoinRequest
JoinRequest.description: Pending membership request created by a signed-in user knowing only the organisation code.

InviteCode.title: InviteCode
InviteCode.description: One-time expiring invite code with preset role and access created by an organisation admin.

School.title: School
School.description: School profile inside an organisation including logo (<150 KB), class groups, subjects, and classes.

Student.title: Student
Student.description: Student record scoped to a single school within an organisation, including Phase 9 Student Register fields (photo, parents, primary & second mobile, address, DOB, admission no & date, previous school, sibling link, transport route & monthly fee, active/left status).

Mark.title: Mark
Mark.description: Subject exam component mark for a student within a school.

MarkEditLog.title: MarkEditLog
MarkEditLog.description: Append-only edit history entry per mark change recording who changed what, when, old value, and new value.

CoScholastic.title: CoScholastic
CoScholastic.description: Co-scholastic area grade for a student and term.

TermInfo.title: TermInfo
TermInfo.description: Attendance, remarks, promotion, and report date per student and term.

AuditLogEntry.title: AuditLogEntry
AuditLogEntry.description: Append-only audit trail recording who changed marks, students, members, or access and when.

Teacher.title: Teacher
Teacher.description: Organisation-level teacher profile (either synced from an approved teacher member or created without a login for timetable setup) supporting multiple schools.

PeriodStructure.title: PeriodStructure
PeriodStructure.description: Per-school editable working days and ordered daily time slots (periods, assembly, short break, lunch).

ClassAssignment.title: ClassAssignment
ClassAssignment.description: Class-section class teacher and per-subject teacher + periods-per-week assignment.

SubjectRule.title: SubjectRule
SubjectRule.description: Optional timetable scheduling preferences per subject in a school (preferred time of day, double period, max once per day).

TimetableCell.title: TimetableCell
TimetableCell.description: Single scheduled timetable cell with deterministic ID (school + session + class + section + day + slot) controlled by the Timetable module.

TeacherLeave.title: TeacherLeave
TeacherLeave.description: Teacher leave record covering a single date or date range (optional half-day slots), with request/approval workflow.

Substitution.title: Substitution
Substitution.description: Date-scoped substitution assignment keyed deterministically by date, school, class, section, and slot; never alters weekly timetable.

TimetableUndoSnapshot.title: TimetableUndoSnapshot
TimetableUndoSnapshot.description: Latest pre-auto-generate snapshot per school and session allowing one-tap Undo auto-generate.

TeacherAccessScope.title: TeacherAccessScope
TeacherAccessScope.description: Server-verified mirror of a linked teacher member's Phase 4 class-section-subject assignments and class teacher sections enforced in Firestore security rules.

TeacherAttendance.title: TeacherAttendance
TeacherAttendance.description: Daily per-school teacher attendance entry (Present, Absent, On Leave, Half-Day) controlled by Timetable module access.

SchoolCalendar.title: SchoolCalendar
SchoolCalendar.description: Per-school and session calendar storing working days of the week, holidays, declared off days, half working days, working day exceptions, and Term-I/Term-II date bounds.

StudentAttendance.title: StudentAttendance
StudentAttendance.description: Deterministic one-doc-per-section-per-date student attendance sheet storing P/A/L/Lt/H statuses, optional reasons, and summary counts.

StudentAttendanceEditLog.title: StudentAttendanceEditLog
StudentAttendanceEditLog.description: Append-only edit history recording who edited a section's student attendance after initial entry, when, and exact per-student diffs.

FeeStructure.title: FeeStructure
FeeStructure.description: Per-school and session fee structure configuring month order, charged months, monthly tuition per class, exam fees & months, optional items catalogue, concession approval limit, and message templates.

StudentFeeOverride.title: StudentFeeOverride
StudentFeeOverride.description: Per-student fee amount overrides with mandatory remark.

FeeReceipt.title: FeeReceipt
FeeReceipt.description: Immutable fee receipt record with running offline-safe receipt number per school and session. Never deleted or edited after issuance; can only transition from ISSUED to CANCELLED with a mandatory cancelReason.

FeeMessageSentLog.title: FeeMessageSentLog
FeeMessageSentLog.description: Deterministic record of a guardian fee message marked as sent via WhatsApp or SMS from the user's phone.

SchoolNotice.title: SchoolNotice
SchoolNotice.description: School notice created in the Notice Maker for copying/sharing to class WhatsApp groups.

FeeAuditLog.title: FeeAuditLog
FeeAuditLog.description: Append-only fee audit trail recording receipt issuance, receipt cancellation, fee structure edits, and per-student overrides.

SchoolCertificate.title: SchoolCertificate
SchoolCertificate.description: Immutable TC, Bonafide, or Character certificate with offline-safe running number per school, session, type, and device node. Can only transition ISSUED -> CANCELLED with a mandatory reason; never deleted.

CashBookSettings.title: CashBookSettings
CashBookSettings.description: Per-school editable expense/other-income categories, default opening balance, and Admin-only large expense approval limit (default Rs. 5000).

CashBookEntry.title: CashBookEntry
CashBookEntry.description: Daily expense or manual other-income entry with optional bill photo, admin approval for large expenses, edit/cancel with mandatory reason, and no silent delete.

CashBookDayClosing.title: CashBookDayClosing
CashBookDayClosing.description: Daily cash reconciliation record storing opening cash, expected closing cash, actual cash counted, and cash difference.

CashBookAuditLog.title: CashBookAuditLog
CashBookAuditLog.description: Append-only Cash Book audit log recording every entry add, edit (with reason), cancellation (with reason), day closing, and settings update.

EnquirySettings.title: EnquirySettings
EnquirySettings.description: Per-school editable enquiry sources list and WhatsApp follow-up message template.

AdmissionEnquiry.title: AdmissionEnquiry
AdmissionEnquiry.description: Admission enquiry tracking child, class wanted, guardian, mobile, source, follow-up date, status (NEW/CONTACTED/VISIT_PLANNED/ADMITTED/LOST), and link to converted Student Register record.

/users/{uid}.description: Private user account and membership index.

/orgCodes/{code}.description: Exact-code public lookup returning only orgId and organisation name.

/organisations/{orgId}/joinRequests/{req.description: Pending membership requests awaiting admin approval.

/organisations/{orgId}/inviteCodes/{invi.description: One-time expiring invite codes with preset roles.

/organisations/{orgId}/schools/{schoolId.description: Append-only per-mark edit history readable by admins and marks viewers.

/organisations/{orgId}/auditLog/{entryId.description: Append-only organisation audit log viewable by admins.

/organisations/{orgId}/teachers/{teacher.description: Organisation teacher profiles controlled by the Teachers and assignments module.

/organisations/{orgId}/periodStructures/.description: Per-school editable period structures controlled by the Teachers and assignments module.

/organisations/{orgId}/classAssignments/.description: Class-subject-teacher assignments and class teachers controlled by the Teachers and assignments module.

/organisations/{orgId}/subjectRules/{rul.description: Optional per-school subject rules stored for timetable scheduling in Phases 5 and 6.

/organisations/{orgId}/timetableCells/{c.description: Timetable cells keyed deterministically by school, session, class, section, day, and slot; controlled by the Timetable module.

/organisations/{orgId}/timetableLayouts/.description: Mirrored per-school slot layout readable by Timetable viewers so view-only members render exact school timings.

/organisations/{orgId}/teacherLeaves/{le.description: Teacher leave requests and approvals controlled by the Timetable module.

/organisations/{orgId}/substitutions/{su.description: Date-scoped daily substitution assignments controlled by the Timetable module.

/organisations/{orgId}/timetableUndoSnap.description: Pre-auto-generate undo snapshots controlled by Timetable edit access.

/organisations/{orgId}/teacherScopes/{me.description: Server-verified teacher access scopes synced from Phase 4 assignments by Admins or Teachers-editors.

/organisations/{orgId}/teacherAttendance.description: Daily per-school teacher attendance records controlled by the Timetable module.

/organisations/{orgId}/schoolCalendars/{.description: Per-school and session calendar (working days, holidays, half days, working day exceptions, Term-I/Term-II dates).

/organisations/{orgId}/studentAttendance.description: Daily student attendance sheet per section per date controlled by the 9th Attendance module and Class Teacher own-section scope.
Append-only edit history for post-day/subsequent edits to student attendance.

/organisations/{orgId}/feeStructures/{st.description: Per-school and session fee structure controlled by the 10th Fees module.

/organisations/{orgId}/studentFeeOverrid.description: Per-student fee overrides with mandatory remark controlled by the 10th Fees module.

/organisations/{orgId}/feeReceipts/{rece.description: Immutable fee receipts controlled by the 10th Fees module.

/organisations/{orgId}/feeMessageSentLog.description: Guardian message sent logs for the Send Queue controlled by the 10th Fees module.

/organisations/{orgId}/schoolNotices/{no.description: School notices created in Notice Maker controlled by the 10th Fees module.

/organisations/{orgId}/feeAuditLogs/{aud.description: Append-only fee audit trail controlled by the 10th Fees module.

/organisations/{orgId}/schoolCertificate.description: Issued and cancelled TC, Bonafide, and Character certificates controlled by the 12th Certificates module.

/organisations/{orgId}/cashBookSettings/.description: Per-school Cash Book categories and Admin approval limit controlled by the 13th Cash Book module.

/organisations/{orgId}/cashBookEntries/{.description: Daily Cash Book expenses and manual other-income entries controlled by the 13th Cash Book module.

/organisations/{orgId}/cashBookDayClosin.description: Daily Cash Book opening/closing cash reconciliation records controlled by the 13th Cash Book module.

/organisations/{orgId}/cashBookAuditLogs.description: Append-only Cash Book audit log controlled by the 13th Cash Book module.

/organisations/{orgId}/enquirySettings/{.description: Per-school Admission Enquiry sources and WhatsApp template controlled by the 14th Enquiry module.

/organisations/{orgId}/admissionEnquirie.description: Admission enquiries and Student Register conversion links controlled by the 14th Enquiry module.

/organisations/{orgId}/examSchedules/{ex.description: Per-school exam schedules, class papers, and admit card fee-dues threshold controlled by the 15th Exams module.

/organisations/{orgId}/examRooms/{roomId.description: Exam rooms with seating capacity controlled by the 15th Exams module.

/organisations/{orgId}/examSeatings/{sea.description: Auto-allocated and manually adjusted exam seating plans controlled by the 15th Exams module.

/organisations/{orgId}/examInvigilatorDu.description: Invigilator room-slot duties controlled by the 15th Exams module; linked teachers can read their own duties.

/organisations/{orgId}/stockTransactions.description: Append-only stock purchases (STOCK_IN) and reasoned manual adjustments (ADJUSTMENT) controlled by the 16th Stock module.

/organisations/{orgId}/transportRoutes/{.description: School transport routes, vehicles, drivers, stops, and monthly fees controlled by the 17th Transport module.
